title: Motorcycle Fork Seal Driver Tool Set Motorcycle Accessories Adjustable Portable with Box for Motorcycle Dirt Bikes
detail_text: Description: 【Easy to Install】Adjustable motorcycle fork seal driver is specially designed for easy installation of fork seals. Recommended working range: 33mm-54mm fork tubes. 【Two-Piece Split Design】This fork seal driver tool has a two-piece design. It is shaped in a way that press the seal into the recess of the fork tube, ensuring a flexible and frictionless sliding, not affected by any narrow space. 【Essential Tool】 Oil seal installation tool set works on either conventional or inverted forks for motorcycles, bikes. Portable with storage box for convenient storage and carry. 【Professional Tool 】Install fork oil seals forks safely and easily without damaging the oil seal, or fork stanchions. Ideal for fork seal changing, makes fork installing seal easier and effortless. 【Heavy Duty Construction】Fork seal driver tool is made of high strength carbon steel for durability and longevity. Specification: Material: Carbon Steel Size Chart: 21.8cmx12cmx5cm/8.58inchx4.72inchx1.97inch Package Includes: 1 Set Fork Seal Driver with Box Note: Easy to Use: 1. Take aparted the fork. 2. Slide the old seal off. 3. Inspect the stanchion 4. Oil the inner surface of the new seal with fresh fork oil. 5. Slip the seal at the top of the stanchion and slide it down to the slider. 6. Adjust the tools plastic fitting to match the size of the seal by loosening cross head screws and decreasing or increasing the diameter. 7. Press the adapters against the seal, slide the driver up and down several times until seal is pushed into the slider.

title: T2P Merchandise Motorcycle Phone Mount with Octopus Grip | Tamper-Resistant Anti-Vibration Bracket
detail_text: 👉 Mounting Options: Choose between Handlebar Mount or Rearview Mirror Mount 👉 Adjustability: Full 360-degree rotation & Anti-Glare angling 👉 Security: Tamper-resistant locking mechanism 👉 Protection: 4-Point Anti-Vibration shock absorption ➖ ✅ Universal Octopus Grip: Designed with a versatile, expanding 8-claw grip. Boasts an adjustable width range of 69-93mm and a height range of 137-212mm, easily accommodating most smartphones—even those with heavy-duty cases up to 21mm thick. ➖ ✅ Ultimate Camera Protection: Engine vibrations can permanently damage modern smartphone cameras. Our 4 sets of integrated shock absorbers significantly dampen high-frequency road vibrations, protecting your phone's delicate Optical Image Stabilization (OIS) lenses and prolonging the life of your device. ➖ ✅ Secure & Scratch-Free: The thick internal padding and soft rubberized cover provide maximum grip without scratching your phone's bezel. Enjoy a confident, secure hold even when navigating the bumpiest terrain or hitting unexpected potholes. ➖ ✅ Tamper-Resistant Security Key: Safely leave your mount attached while you step away. Our exclusive security key allows you to lock the mounting screws firmly in place, preventing quick dismantling and keeping your bracket safe from opportunistic tampering. ➖ ✅ Anti-Glare & Multi-Use: The fully adjustable 360-degree ball joint allows you to easily tilt your screen to cut out sun glare for perfect visibility. Beyond smartphones, the stable base can also firmly hold small action cameras to capture your ride!
